label: Admittance entries
subgoals: Convert the capacitance and frequency to an admittance
Stamp it as an imaginary conductance pattern
Keep resistive and controlled-source entries real

label: Solving one complex node
subgoals: Form the complex admittance of the node
Divide the source amplitude by the magnitude

label: Phase of the response
subgoals: Compute the ratio of susceptance to conductance
Take minus the arctangent of the ratio
